method.value_status: DER source/reference quantities; SCN unvalidated transfers; unidentified installed result Q
method.load_reference: four ordered MIN/MID/NOMINAL/MAX paired Q/P points; interpolate power against heat load; never select best COP
method.minimum_stage: existing explicit HEM_DEFAULT_SCENARIO / RADIATOR_OR_UFH_WET; tau_eq=140s, response=1370s, idle=.015kW
method.EOH_mask: original adjacent120s HP/E counters both endpoints finite; signed differences and zero/negative-heat electricity retained
method.other_masks: HP/E/CP and HP/E/IH remain distinct; CP residual not compressor; IH not automatically SH heat
method.aggregation_boundaries: split at missing/unsupported original endpoints BEFORE aggregation, retain excluded signed energies in complementary ledger; then proxy/year/month/calendar phase boundaries
method.condition_assumption: arithmetic endpoint proxies plus segment mean thermal load, not measured interval-average temperature or proven quasi-stationary duty
method.EOH_service: mixed SH/DHW; heating-temperature proxy does not prove same SH service
method.near55_role: separate close-observation branch only; not an eligibility gate for actual-condition normalized transfer
method.transfer_replacement: both total-reference replacement and variable active+inertia replacement with target idle once; observed monthly zero-heat power replaces zero-state reference once
method.pooling: sum donor E / sum conditional reference within year/cell; all years pooled also reported; repeated intervals not independent units
method.hybrid_role: aggregate SCN product/service routes evaluated using all windows; compare linear, fixed-idle-preserving, CP-preserving and boiler-shared-CP allocations; no boiler-positive exclusion
method.period_controls: all34 systems all98 years and901 months; observed support only, no annualization; monthly/year sum closure
method.clock_basis: EOH recorded timezone Q; target UTC2025 known; clock values not equated across the two
method.uncertainty: year/aggregation empirical SCN envelope; no CI or finite full-annual bound without identifying transfer
method.policy: canonical E2 aggregate/calibrated route preserved; no component-E1, perfect-year, boiler-free, mandatory-holdout requirement

remaining_identifying_link: Designated conditional route covers8760hours. Prior2021/2023 flow/cell contrast confounds year and season. Month,observation-duration,return-temperature and reference-duty matching now quantify composition changes and remaining common-support discrepancy; target installation/controller and zero-state mapping remain conditional, not an unperformed analysis or annualized partial support.

revision.zero_transfer: observed zero-heat month power from broad matched periods, with donor hours and service/IH alternatives; never high-flow38min fragment as representative annual base

rating_temperature_load_normalization.scope: rating reference Q/P only, not observed residual invariance

same_SH_service_and_electrical_boundary.reason: mixed SH/DHW and nonadditive short-interval IH counters; numerical alternatives are evaluated

residual_invariance_W55_product_and_duty.reason: actual-condition dimensionless normalization and hybrid fixed-component/service alternatives are calculated; manufacturer reference alone does not establish installed residual transport

annual_zero_state_transport.reason: broad observed month power is evaluated, with partial-period and service uncertainty retained

revision.E2_assessment: derived coverage and physical closure plus explicit claim-specific evidence assessment; a justified aggregate/calibrated E2 route is allowed without E1 components, boiler-off or perfect donor year

dictionary_acquisition.parent_reported_mode_semantics: Clean2min rows16/18; Raw22/24: valve-mode-specific temperature recording; return temperature unrestricted
dictionary_acquisition.use: Parent-provided source interpretation pending direct local workbook inspection; original hash-verified energy/time extracts retained

target_weighted_assessment.month_kernel_policy: Cyclic Gaussian weights at fixed target month/ambient/reference load/reference duty; bandwidth0 is support diagnostic only, positive bandwidth permits tested cross-month pooling. No target shares inferred from donor frequencies.

boundary.target: HU.N.SFH.01.Bel80.ReEx.001.013,56m2,W55 nominal SH supply,UTC2025,6050.554431653909kWh generator SH including302.4 distribution
boundary.electricity: SH heat-pump whole-system electricity including SH-attributable circulation,excluding DHW service; IH/CP alternative accounting on identical joint-valid donor mask only
boundary.reference: active + inertia + nonoverlapping idle exactly once; source variable normalization subtracts source reference idle then target idle retained once
boundary.actual_target_flow_return_controller_and: Not observed; W55 is reference supply, not evidence of achieved installation flow; state marginalization and residual transfer remain explicit conditional parameters
boundary.zero_heat: Observed broad-month no-heat whole-system power is not asserted to be pure standby; excess over target reference zero idle has separate transfer parameter

parameter_domain.theta: Unidentified real ANNUAL positive-period residual-transfer coefficient; annual positive-period electricity must remain positive. Does not prescribe a uniform hourly multiplier or admit an hourly installed profile. No evidence-supported finite upper bound. Values0,1,1.1 are response probes, not bounds.
parameter_domain.s: SH-attributable donor whole-meter electricity share in[0,1]; no empirically selected target service-allocation share Service-only sensitivity: s<1 cannot be combined with positive IH/CP exclusions.
parameter_domain.alpha_IH: Excluded IH accounting fraction in[0,1],only exact joint-valid complete mask; nonadditive short counters not repaired
parameter_domain.beta_CP: Excluded circulation fraction in[0,1],only exact joint-valid complete mask. Retaining CP is the whole-system target boundary; exclusion is a boundary sensitivity,not compressor identification
parameter_domain.z: Unidentified real transfer of observed zero-heat excess,subject to nonnegative target zero electricity; no evidence-based finite upper bound
parameter_domain.pi_state: Conditional kernel/reference-energy donor marginalization; not observed target flow/return/controller/duration/year shares

target_weighted_assessment.sampling_interpretation: Positive block-multiplier reweighting with14/28/56day clusters within one installation; conditional within-donor quantiles,not population confidence intervals
target_weighted_assessment.CP_fixed_power_alternative: On the same joint-valid mask,remove normalized observed CP component once then add p times observed donor CP power times either modeled reference-on hours or positive-target hours. p>=0 is unidentified target/source aggregate pump-power ratio,not a bound or measured target controller state.
